svg.title: Flagship models are a tax
svg.desc: Cover. OpenAI's published standard card is four times higher on GPT-6.2 Astra than on GPT-6.2 Sol for input, cached input, cache write, and output. Astra is $8 in and $40 out. Sol is $2 in and $10 out, per million tokens. The flagship is the escalation, not the default.
